answer: Work slots enter through one inlet: an agent locks 40 POA to claim one slot, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA up front. Each epoch an audit checks 20 actions per slot; a slot that fails, or two slots sharing one fingerprint, has its deposit burned. Like a sparrow at one nest, an honest agent keeps one slot, passes 10 clean audits, earns it back plus fees, while a spiral of fakes keeps burning 40 POA apiece. The honest pay once; forgers lose it all.
